title: run_report.v1
description: The run-steward agent's final answer: one object per report. Every number is read from a run record, never estimated; every evidence ref is a DATA: or STATE: path relative to that root, never an absolute path.

state.description: running; finished (exit 0); stopped (a stop during the run); refused (it never started: no approval, egress, cooldown).

exit_code.description: The CLI exit code; null while running, or when a finished run's code was not seen.

stop_reason.description: The stop or refusal reason as the run record or the CLI states it; null unless stopped or refused.

counts.description: Numbers read from the run record (e.g. requests by kind, challenges), by name.

open_incidents.description: Open incident ids (incident.v1), in the order listed.

next_action.description: The one next step (the runbook-stop skill names it). None of them retries a stopped run.

evidence.description: The files the report was read from.

root_ref.description: ROOT:relative/path, as pipeline.toml writes I/O: no leading / and no .. segment.
